g.title: TropheopsPedigree
g.text: Tropheops pedigree — Tier A (strict identity stability)
F2: 38 both parents, 30 one parent, 28 unresolved; exact joint pairs in this view=37
Edge colours: grey=G0→F1 inferred seed; green=Tier A; blue=Tier B only; orange=leading hypothesis below Tier B; red dotted=forced uncertain father. Squares=male; circles=female.
